analysis.title: Marvell Technology Inc. (MRVL): Announces definitive agreement to acquire Lumentum
key_insights: On November 2 before market open, Marvell and Lumentum (not covered by GS) announced a definitive all-stock agreement for Marvell to acquire Lumentum.

Terms: Lumentum shareholders receive 4.5 Marvell shares per Lumentum share. Pro forma ownership is about 67% Marvell shareholders and 33% Lumentum shareholders, equating to a $125bn enterprise value for Lumentum at the announced price.
Management says the deal lifts the combined 2030 TAM from ~$490bn standalone to ~$550bn, including ~$60bn of incremental opportunity from NPO and CPO (near-package and co-packaged optics).
Management's rationale is that AI networking is shifting from copper toward optics, and combining the portfolios allows tighter co-design, end-to-end solutions and faster time to market.
Supply: Lumentum's internal InP (indium phosphide) fabs paired with Marvell's supply chain partnerships are meant to strengthen supply assurance, given AI-driven component demand is outpacing supply.
Management expects the deal to be accretive to Marvell's non-GAAP EPS one year after close, supported by stronger growth, margin expansion and over $1bn of run-rate cost synergies, mainly in COGS.
GS is Not Rated on Marvell, with rating, price target and estimates removed because Goldman Sachs is acting as financial advisor to Marvell on the announced transaction.
earnings_insights: GS forecasts shown for MRVL (estimates, not reported, GS estimates predate the deal): FY1/27E EPS $3.05, FY1/28E EPS $6.12, FY1/29E EPS $12.15, versus FY1/26 EPS $2.16. Quarterly GS EPS estimates: 10/26E $0.76, 1/27E $1.13, 4/27E $1.20, against 7/26 $0.59.
GS revenue forecasts for MRVL ($ mn): FY1/26 8,194.6, FY1/27E 12,238.3, FY1/28E 20,471.3, FY1/29E 35,118.9.
risk_factors: The report's price target methodology and risks section says only that GS is Not Rated on Marvell and names no specific deal risks.
Stated conflict of interest: Goldman Sachs is acting as financial advisor to Marvell on the announced strategic matter.
